name: MNTTRDB2.jcl
description:
This JCL job (MNTTRDB2) executes the COBTUPDT program under DB2 system DAZ1 using the CARDDEMO plan, processing transaction records from an input sequential file to perform maintenance updates against the DB2 database. The job runs as a batch DB2-connected COBOL program designed to update transaction-related data in the CardDemo application.Key Functionalities:
Reads transaction records from the input sequential file (INPFILE / TR-RECORD) to drive the update process
Executes the COBTUPDT COBOL program connected to DB2 system DAZ1 under the CARDDEMO application plan to apply transaction maintenance updates
Performs database maintenance operations against DB2 tables within the CardDemo application using the loaded COBOL program and its associated DBRM library

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO database on DB2 system DAZ1 is available and accessible, the INPFILE containing Transaction Records (TR-RECORD) is present and ready for shared read access, and the CARDDEMO database plan is bound and available for execution
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The COBTUPDT program is executed under the CARDDEMO database plan against DB2 system DAZ1
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All Transaction Records present in INPFILE are read sequentially and the corresponding update operations are applied to the CARDDEMO database on DB2 system DAZ1, with all execution messages and processing results captured in the system print output

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - COBTUPDT - Transaction Record Database Update
rules.Rule_Description: This step invokes the external COBTUPDT COBOL program to read all incoming Transaction Records from the INPFILE input file and apply the corresponding updates to the CARDDEMO database on DB2 system DAZ1. The INPFILE is accessed in shared mode, allowing concurrent read access by other processes. No conditional logic governs this step — all records are processed unconditionally to completion.
